sections.name: Opening swell and first chant
sections.observation: The first 5.5 s are nearly silent. A swelling tone leads into the chant at 6.63 s. The words change around 10.1 s while the bass holds G. It falls to E♭ at 11.65 s. On the second E♭ pedal, A, C, D and F overlap again at 23.6–24.2 s.

sections.name: Low pulses move forward
sections.observation: At 26.73 s a series of heavy low-frequency attacks comes forward. The rhythm at 32.30–35.50 s closely matches its return eight bars later at 42.35–45.55 s. The instrumental stem sustains D4 around 36.81–37.53 s and reaches F5 at 38.01–38.79 s.

sections.name: The bass recedes
sections.observation: The low end of the accented beats drops away near 46.84 s. The midrange continues as the bass starts to fill in again around 51.86 s. A pitched component sits near G3 at 47.01–47.85 s, then near E4 at 51.87–52.77 s.

sections.name: Bass and percussion build
sections.observation: From 56.89 s, deep bass and bright percussion enter together, with brief gaps before the chant returns near 77 s. Above the bass, the instrumental line reaches D5 at 61.90–62.44 s and F5 at 65.14–65.92 s.

sections.name: Return of the opening chant
sections.observation: The opening chant returns 70.37 s later. The change in articulation recurs at 80.47 s. The midrange waveform closely matches the first entrance, while the high-frequency detail changes. At 83.14–84.17 s the voice holds B♭4 above E2. The corresponding bass in the first pass was E♭1.

sections.name: Thinning texture and returning pulse
sections.observation: After 97.10 s both the deep bass and upper frequencies recede. The chant trails on until about 99 s. The instrumental line moves from F5 at 101.33–101.99 s to C♯5 at 102.29–102.95 s. A steady bass pitch is difficult to identify here. A clearer low pulse returns around 107.15 s.

sections.name: Rapid vocal phrases and their repeat
sections.observation: The voice emerges around 115.55 s, strengthens near 116.6 s, and precedes the fuller arrangement at 117.2 s. The bass shows an F♯1 harmonic series near 117.55 s. Short phrases give way to sustained notes. A high vocal-like line moves from G♯5 to F♯5 at 137.38–140.85 s, followed by a gap around 141.0–141.5 s.

sections.name: Sustained vocal response
sections.observation: A pitched layer returns in the vocal stem near 141.6 s. It holds near F♯5 at 145.02–145.78 s, then drops to F5 and recedes abruptly around 147.4 s. Its sustained tone is particularly clear in the isolated stem.

sections.name: Instrumental continuation
sections.observation: As the vocal recedes, the drums and remaining instruments stay close to their previous level. The rhythmic backing is exposed at 147.4–155.9 s. C♯5 recurs around 149.21–149.69 s and 154.37–154.79 s. A brief vocal-like sound follows 156 s.

sections.name: Break before the final attacks
sections.observation: The texture thins near 157.41 s. The average level over the next five seconds is about 5.7 dB below the following section. At 160.91–161.85 s a swell closely matches the opening waveform at 5.57–6.51 s, now against different accompaniment.

sections.name: Final low attacks and decay
sections.observation: The bass re-enters around 162.44 s, with an instrumental tone near C♯4 at 165.0 s. After 167 s the final attacks give way to a decaying tail. The isolated vocal is faint after 167.5 s. The source ends at 172.99 s.

bassSegments.evidence: Weak or ambiguous at the entrance; stronger G subharmonics later.
Main pedal, with short local deviations.
Fades; omit the remaining uncertain tail.

meta.pitch: A4 = 440 Hz and C4 = MIDI 60. The vocal contour combines Praat autocorrelation, harmonic support and an amplitude gate. Bass octaves were checked against the lowest partials.
meta.limits: The contour follows a prominent periodic component. Doubled voices, bleed and noise can obscure the pitch. Ambiguous frames are left blank. Confidence indicates tracking quality.
meta.vocalRange: Predominant vocal pitch was searched between MIDI notes 47 and 85. Overlapping vocal lines may share a single displayed contour.
meta.bassRange: Bass candidates span MIDI notes 21–45. Stable segment labels are omitted in ambiguous passages.
meta.rms: Short-window stereo RMS on the estimated vocal stem, in dBFS. The plotted envelope includes the common gain used for playback.
